from math import ceil

# login
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0]
resp_login = apis.spotify.login(username='vicpowe@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token = resp_login['access_token']
print('logged_in', access_token[:10])

# fetch all liked songs with pagination
page_limit = 20
all_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-liked_at')
    print('liked_songs_page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_songs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

print('total_liked_songs', len(all_songs))
# extract unique artist ids from all songs
artist_ids = set()
artist_names_by_id = {}
for s in all_songs:
    for a in s.get('artists', []) or []:
        aid = a.get('id')
        aname = a.get('name')
        if aid is not None:
            artist_ids.add(aid)
            if aid not in artist_names_by_id and aname:
                artist_names_by_id[aid] = aname

print('unique_artists_from_liked_songs', len(artist_ids))
print('sample_artist_ids', list(artist_ids)[:10])
print('sample_artist_names', [artist_names_by_id.get(i) for i in list(artist_ids)[:10]])
